How Much CBD Should I Take?

When starting a CBD regimen, we recommend beginning with 10-20mg of CBD per day for the first week to ensure it is well tolerated.

You can then gradually increase your daily dose by increments of 5mg until you find your optimal dose, depending on what feels best for you.

settings.title: Can I use multiple types of CBD at the same time?
settings.text:
While CBD does not cause any intoxicating effects, beginners should stick to small doses at first and build up gradually. It’s best not to use too many different CBD products all at once, as it can make it hard to fully understand what you’re benefiting from or you could end up taking more CBD than you need.  

Orally consumed CBD has a half-life of between 10 and 20 hours, therefore you’ll want to space out any different products you might be using. The advantage of this approach is that you’ll maximize the benefits you get from a single product without wasting any, and you get to see which type of CBD product gives you the most benefits.
